title: Sandbox-host LaunchProcess/KillProcess/GetProcessStatus RPCs
description:
Implement the three new RPC endpoints on the sandbox-host service: LaunchProcess,
KillProcess, and GetProcessStatus. This is the sandbox-host side that NativeSandboxControl
delegates to.

Reference doc: docs/plans/11-sandbox-host-service.add03.md (full standalone addendum)

Key deliverables:
- internal/rpc/api/types.go — New RPC API types: LaunchProcessRequest/Response,
  KillProcessRequest/Response, GetProcessStatusRequest/Response, ProcessStatus
- internal/rpc/codec/sandbox_map.go — Codec mappings for new process management types
- internal/rpc/transport/server.go — Register 3 new ConnectRPC procedures under
  /rpc.v1.SandboxService/ (LaunchProcess, KillProcess, GetProcessStatus)
- internal/sandbox/service.go — Extend SandboxHostService with process management:
  - ManagedProcess tracking (per-session process map)
  - LaunchProcess: gVisor path (bind-mount ZFS at /workspace, run in container) and
    direct execution path (no gVisor)
  - Port proxying: TCP reverse proxy on dynamically allocated port
  - PID tracking and background process monitoring goroutine
  - KillProcess: send signal to tracked PID
  - GetProcessStatus: check PID status, exit code
- internal/rpc/server/sandbox_server.go — New RPC handlers delegating to service
- Session destroy cleanup: kill all launched processes before ZFS/directory cleanup
- Unit tests for all process management logic
- Integration tests for direct execution + port proxy lifecycle

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/11-sandbox-host-service.add03.md (all sections)
- Parent plan: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc.md §6 (SandboxControl LaunchProcess spec)
- Depends on: existing sandbox-host service (aiag-zvy epic)
